The team lists these developers by area, with the condition for each. "Needs info" in `workflow.md` says when you may needinfo one, and how to use the fallback list.

- `padenot@mozilla.com`: Web Audio, WebCodecs, Web Speech, audio-specific issues.
- `karlt@mozbugz.karlt.net`: Web Audio, MediaStreamGraph (MTG).
- `kinetik@flim.org`: cubeb, AudioIPC.
- `cchang@mozilla.com`: WebCodecs.
- `aosmond@mozilla.com`: GMP, Android NDK, graphics in media.
- `jolin@mozilla.com`: Android, HLS.
- `azebrowski@mozilla.com`: Media Capabilities, codec support.
- `alwu@mozilla.com`: autoplay, WebVTT, PlayReady.
- `stransky@anakreon.cz`: Linux hardware video decoding (VA-API, V4L2, ffvpx-hw). Ask only when: The bug is on Linux and involves hardware video decoding. about:support must show that hardware decoding is available. Do not ask when HARDWARE_VIDEO_DECODING is unavailable or blocklisted, or when Codec Support lists only SWDEC. Do not ask when any GPU in about:support is NVIDIA or the bug involves Vulkan: ask tboiko@nvidia.com.
- `tboiko@nvidia.com`: NVIDIA GPUs on Linux, Vulkan video decoding. Ask only when: The bug is on Linux and any GPU in about:support is NVIDIA, also on a laptop with a second GPU, or the bug involves Vulkan, for example Vulkan video decoding.

Fallback list: `alwu@mozilla.com`, `padenot@mozilla.com`, `jmathies@mozilla.com`.

# Issue types

The values for `issue_type`, as step 3 in `workflow.md` says. `other` is also allowed.

- `playback-failure`: does not start, error, unsupported format.
- `stall-freeze`: plays, then stops, freezes or skips.
- `av-sync`: audio and video out of sync.
- `audio-output`: no sound, glitches, crackling, wrong device.
- `video-rendering`: corruption, wrong colors, green frames, scaling.
- `performance`: high CPU or memory, dropped frames.
- `codec-support`: hardware or software decoder or encoder availability, MediaCapabilities.
- `drm`: EME, Widevine, PlayReady, GMP.
- `capture`: getUserMedia, MediaRecorder, camera, microphone.
- `web-api`: Web Audio, Web Codecs, Web Speech, media element spec behavior.
